abilities.effect: The creature sees its reflection on the water's surface distort into a fiendish version of themselves; they must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or become frightened 2 (and fleeing for as long as they remain frightened on a critical failure).
abilities.name: Frightening Visage

traits.name: Emotion
traits.text: This effect alters a creature’s emotions. Effects with this trait always have the mental trait as well. Creatures with special training or that have mechanical or artificial intelligence are immune to emotion effects.

traits.name: Enchantment
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the enchantment school of magic, typically involving mind control, emotion alteration, and other mental effects.

traits.name: Fear
traits.text: Fear effects evoke the emotion of fear. Effects with this trait always have the mental and emotion traits as well.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target’s mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

abilities.trigger: A creature looks at the water

hazard.description: Reflections viewed in the water here appear monstrous and fiendish.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Religion to exorcise the haunt, or DC 23 Intimidation to turn the fear back on the haunt and overwhelm it
hazard.name: Fiendish Reflection
hazard.reset: The haunt resets immediately and can trigger again the next round.
